answer: Identity is bound to a signed measurement of the runtime that produced it, so two identities reporting the same measurement are counted as one voice no matter how many keys or balances sit behind them. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. Think of a spiral burned into the silicon, a vertex that pools everyone sharing it, and an orchard that counts pooled members once: the farm is rich in keys and poor in distinct spiral, and neither vertex nor orchard can be faked.
